subject: Residency credit split + HSM seat pricing for MedAssist - proposal
messages:
From: Dana Liu <dana.liu@medassist.com>
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com; marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@medassist.com
Date: 2026-11-14T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Clarify residency credits + HSM seat costs

Hi Vivek / Marissa,

Thanks for the call today. Two quick follow-ups from procurement and our security team so we can move this through our SSO/compliance review:

1) Residency credits — we need a line item showing how you’d allocate a 10% discount for committing to US-only residency for the next 12 months vs. global. Procurement wants to see the delta as taxable credit items.
2) HSM usage — your team mentioned an HSM "seat" model. Can you confirm OPEX vs CAPEX treatment and if the first-seat setup fee is one-time? Also need monthly per-seat unit price.
3) Audit logs / S3 retention — provide the incremental per-GB cost and whether Redwood can export raw logs to our S3 for 7 years (regulator requires 7y retention).

We’d appreciate a short updated quote/PDF we can circulate to legal and finance.

Best,
Dana Liu
Head of IT Compliance
MedAssist

Attachments: none

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Dana Liu <dana.liu@medassist.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-14T12:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Clarify residency credits + HSM seat costs

Hi Dana — thanks for the clear list. I pulled together an initial response below and we will formalize into a short quote PDF by Monday.

Quick answers up front:
- Residency credits: we can model a 10% discount applied to the base hosted API consumption (tokens + embeddings) when you sign a 12-month US-only residency commitment. We will break this out as an explicit "Residency Credit" line item in the quote so Procurement can apply it against invoices.
- HSM seat: first-seat setup is a one-time provisioning fee; subsequent seats charged monthly. We present it as an operational charge (monthly). If your finance team prefers CAPEX amortization language we can provide a capitalizable invoice template but the billing remains monthly unless you take Dedicated/Private with a different contract.
- Audit logs: we support exporting raw audit logs to your S3. Incremental storage is charged at $0.02/GB/month when exported; if retained on Redwood-managed storage it's $0.03/GB/month with longer-term retention discounts at volume tiers.

I'll loop in Marissa and Karthik — Marissa will finalize the quote and list attachments, Karthik will confirm any one-off credit/approval we should pre-authorize.

Talk soon,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Compliance & Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com; karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-15T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Clarify residency credits + HSM seat costs (internal)

Vivek / Karthik — forwarding Dana's list so I can get quick confirmation on numbers before I create the quote PDF. Proposed numbers below (please review):

1) Residency credit split:
- Base hosted API (tokens + embeddings): list price assumed $0.0006/token-unit equivalent
- 12-month US-only residency commitment = 10% credit applied monthly to the base usage invoice as "Residency Credit" (shows as negative line item).
- If customer chooses Dedicated/Private later, credit converts pro-rata to a "migration credit" up to 6 months.

2) HSM seat model:
- One-time provisioning/setup: $7,500 (covers HSM key material setup and KMS integration).
- Monthly per-seat (management + SLA): $1,200/seat/month for first 3 seats, volume tiers after.
- If they sign a 12-month dedicated contract we can convert to a 20% discount on seat monthly charges.

3) Audit logs / S3 retention:
- Export to customer S3: no egress charge from Redwood; incremental processing and indexing $0.01/GB/month.
- Redwood-managed retention: $0.03/GB/month; 12-month commitment drops to $0.025/GB/month; 36-month commitment drops to $0.02/GB/month.

Open questions for Karthik / finance:
- Can we pre-approve a one-time credit of up to $15k (account-level) for onboarding if procurement asks for a "first-year onboarding credit"? Customer argued onboarding effort is upfront.
- Legal: need to confirm contract language for S3 exports and 7-year retention (we should propose a data transfer SLA + custodian responsibility clause).

If you both sign off I’ll assemble the quote and MAP (mutual action plan) and attach to Dana.

Thanks — Marissa

Attachments: none

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com; vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-15T14:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Clarify residency credits + HSM seat costs (internal)

Marissa — good draft. Approve the numbers with two caveats:

1) Onboarding credit: authorize up to $10k one-time onboarding credit from Sales budget. Anything above $10k needs VP approval. We can position it as a "one-time migration credit" tied to signatures + 30-day milestone.
2) HSM monthly seat: reduce first-seat monthly to $950/seat/month for this deal only, in exchange for a 12-month commitment and commit to a 20% early-payment discount. That gets us competitive but preserves margin.

Legal to confirm 7-year S3 retention wording, but engineering has confirmed we can stream exports and keep raw logs on their S3 with signed manifest files. Please include a one-line "custodian responsibility" note in the MAP.

Once you update I’ll greenlight the PDF.

— Karthik
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
